2.18.5 release (previous 2.18.4) + release notes updated by CI build 3418

[ci skip-release]

Avoid circularity: If certain types a type for the first time during instrumentation while our mocking engine relies on the same types, this can cause a circularity as checking if an instance is a mock requires instances of the latter types what again returns to the latter mock checking routine what causes an endless loop. (Described in comment.) Fixes #1240. (#1378)
